data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghaliyah means 'she who protects or guards'. This name is derived from the verb 'ghalaha', which means 'to protect, shield, or preserve'. In Islamic tradition, Ghaliyah can represent one's guardian angel, who protects and guides us throughout our lives. The name Ghaliyah carries the meaning “Protector or Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaliyah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector or guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
